configurations._comment: Attach-only: start the server yourself with `python3 board/serve.py --port 8766`, then this opens the preview. Port moved off 8765 on 2026-08-31: an unrelated long-running stream_server.py owns that port on this machine, so the board could not bind and the preview showed its WebSocket error page instead. A launching config (runtimeExecutable) is refused here — the preview sandbox cannot exec files under the project directory.
configurations.name: board-dashboard
